name: podcast
description: Two-person podcast short (host + guest). Same stage chain as qa; differs in framing and caption color. Pick the framing that matches how it was shot (see notes).

notes.reframe (one wide two-shot camera): split.segments='all' stacks host top / guest bottom for the whole clip (set split.top/bottom ROIs to each person's side of the frame). Or list only some segment indices to mix a close-up with a split payoff.
notes.reframe (one camera per person, or a swi: preset='podcast' (scene-split on by default: the tracker resets at every camera cut). For a cut that jumps between separate source files, use per_segment=true.
notes.captions.speaker_mics: If each person has their own mic/lav track, set {host, guest, offset_s} so caption color comes from whose mic is louder (white=host, yellow=guest). Without it the director colors guest turns from the transcript.
notes.captions.layout: split segments ride the 50% seam automatically; close-up segments sit below the chin (closeup_y_pct).
